2609.31571.title: Strategically Diverse Sampling for Self-Training
2609.31571.paper_summary: Many LLM training and inference methods, including RL and test-time scaling, depend on repeated sampling, but benefit only when the responses meaningfully differ. Self-training faces the same challenge: training data is typically constructed by sampling IID responses and filtering primarily for correctness, thereby overrepresenting strategies a model already favours. We investigate strategic diversity, or substantive variation among approaches to a problem, as an alternative principle for constructing self-training data. We generate strategically diverse data with two sampling methods: GROOT, a new method which constructs a hierarchical tree of approaches and samples distinct paths, and Verbalized Sampling (VS), adapted to produce an unstructured set of approaches. Across competitive programming and Next-Chapter Prediction domains, models trained on strategically sampled data outperform IID-trained counterparts on difficult tasks and provide strong initializations for RL and test-time scaling. Most strikingly, self-training on strategically diverse but incorrect traces from Qwen3-4B outperforms IID distillation from a 235B teacher. These results challenge prevailing assumptions about what makes useful self-training data and show that diversity of approaches can matter more than correctness or teacher scale.
2609.31571.paper_summary_zh: 許多 LLM 訓練和推理方法，包括 RL 和測試時縮放，依賴於重複取樣，但只有在回應有意義的差異時才會受益。自我訓練面臨相同的挑戰：訓練數據通常是通過取樣 IID 回應並主要過濾正確性來構建的，因此過度代表了模型已經偏好的策略。我們探討策略多樣性，即在解決問題的方法之間的實質性變化，作為構建自我訓練數據的另一原則。我們使用兩種取樣方法生成策略多樣化的數據：GROOT，一種新方法，它構建了一個方法的層次樹並取樣不同的路徑，以及 Verbalized Sampling (VS)，調整以生成一組非結構化的方法。在競爭性編程和下一章預測領域，基於策略取樣數據訓練的模型在困難任務上超越 IID 訓練的對手，並為 RL 和測試時縮放提供強有力的初始化。最引人注目的是，基於 Qwen3-4B 的策略多樣化但不正確的痕跡進行自我訓練，超越了來自 235B 老師的 IID 蒸餾。這些結果挑戰了對於什麼構成有用自我訓練數據的普遍假設，並顯示方法的多樣性可能比正確性或教師規模更為重要。
